name: Schwab Crypto Thematic Natural Language Processing ETF (formerly known as Schwab Crypto Thematic ETF)

source.productPageRendering: read-only rendering proxy (r.jina.ai) of the official product page
source.holdingsSource: schwabassetmanagement.com full holdings CSV export (STCE_FundHoldings_2026-09-17.CSV, via read-only rendering proxy)
source.historySource: Yahoo Finance public chart API (adjusted close)
source.distributionsSource: schwabassetmanagement.com distribution history CSV export (Total Distribution per share, via read-only rendering proxy)
source.provider: Schwab Asset Management product finder + official product page + per-fund holdings/distribution CSV exports + SEC EDGAR Form N-PORT-P fallback + Yahoo Finance public chart API

identifiers.isinBasis: derived from the published CUSIP (US prefix + check digit)

expenseRatio.kind: Total Expense Ratio published on the official product page (net expense ratio in the product finder)

marketPrice.source: Yahoo Finance last regular-session price (the anonymous product page publishes no closing price)

aum.source: official product page Total Net Assets

yields.dividendYieldKind: Distribution Yield (TTM) published on the official product page as of Aug 31 2026
yields.secYieldKind: SEC Yield (30 Day) published on the official product page as of Sep 17 2026

returns.derivedFrom: official Schwab product-page NAV total returns (month-end) where published; Yahoo adjusted market-price closes for missing values

distributions.source: schwabassetmanagement.com distribution history CSV export (Total Distribution per share, via read-only rendering proxy)

holdings.source: schwabassetmanagement.com full holdings CSV export (STCE_FundHoldings_2026-09-17.CSV, via read-only rendering proxy)
holdings.marketValueBasis: derived: Percent of Assets x Total Net Assets (the issuer CSV publishes weights, not values)

history.source: Yahoo Finance public chart API (adjusted close)
